thread:
tom: Thanks everyone — quick follow-ups from today's all-hands about the roadmap. TL;DR: need clarity on three timelines (API streaming v2, Console per-tenant rollout, Optimize quantization guidance). Can @priya or @devon confirm?

priya: Short answers below — I'll follow up with concrete docs and dates by EOD.

devon: API streaming v2: aiming for beta in ~6 weeks, GA in ~12 weeks. Blocker: kernel perf for long-context streaming; we'll run an extra perf sweep next week.

anya: For Console per-tenant rollout: what's the exact gating mechanism? feature flags + telemetry only or additional manual checks?

carlos: Console rollout plan = feature flags + cohorts + rollbacks. Initial cohort = internal + 3 pilot customers. Acceptance = telemetry shows <5% error rate and no perf regressions in the 72h window.

tom: Can we get a concise canary -> cohort -> GA checklist so product teams can plan migrations?

devon: Sure — rough checklist below:

```
1) internal canary (1 week) — monitor tracing/errors and tail latency
2) 3-customer pilot (2 weeks) — validate config/role mappings and support playbooks
3) staged ramp (2 weeks) — 10% -> 50% traffic with automated rollback triggers
4) GA — enable opt-in and schedule full rollout
```

priya: Optimize (quantization recommendations): preview in ~3 weeks, automated suggestion engine and model profiles by EOW quarter. We'll publish per-model notes (accuracy vs cost tradeoffs). :eyes: 

anya: For Dedicated customers — will quantization be automatic or opt-in? some legal teams need opt-in guarantees.

carlos: Opt-in for GA. We'll offer auto-suggested profiles in Console but require explicit opt-in before applying to production workload.

tom: About API v2 streaming — will rate-limiting semantics change? SDK owners need to know for backward compatibility.

devon: No change to core rate limits at launch. We'll add a small header for partial-flush behavior and an extension point for SDKs to expose streaming chunk events. SDK owners will be looped in the doc.

priya: I'll publish a short follow-up doc + timeline tomorrow and run a 30-min sync (11:00 AM PT). @tom can you collate the list of internal teams + customers who want early access?

tom: Yup — will DM the list and drop it in the thread by EOD. Thanks! :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: New doc uploaded: https://go.redwood/docs/roadmap/streaming-console-optimize-followup (permissions: internal)
